findings.title: Native controls lose nested React context
findings.reproduction: A Control child under an application context provider inside Map receives the outside default when moved to the adapter overlay host.
findings.expected: Preserve the original React ancestry for custom control children.
findings.verification: Focused mocked native component reproduction failed: expected inside, received outside.

findings.title: A stale unprojection rejection cancels a newer drag proposal
findings.affected: Live dragging on both native adapters
findings.reproduction: Start dragging, leave one unprojection pending, resolve a later move successfully, then reject the older request. The catch lacks the request-sequence guard used by the success path and calls cancel().
findings.expected: Ignore both successes and failures from superseded requests.
findings.verification: Focused mocked native component reproduction failed: gesture lock calls were true then false instead of remaining true.

findings.title: Equivalent style objects cause duplicate onStyleLoad notifications
findings.affected: Both web adapters; TF03 lifecycle behavior
findings.reproduction: Rerender an already loaded map with a fresh object containing the same style. The layout effect rearms on reference identity and immediately reports another completed style load.
findings.expected: Notify for actual style completion or genuine missed-load recovery, without re-reporting an unchanged style.
findings.verification: Focused mocked web component reproduction failed: two notifications instead of one.
